alternativas.feedback: Correto. A mucosal membrane (mucosa) lines the lumen of organ systems that open to the exterior of the body (digestive, respiratory and genitourinary). Correto. The mucous membrane, or mucosa, lines the lumens of all organs opening directly or indirectly to the exterior of the body, such as the stomach, intestines, trachea, and ureter. Typically, the mucosa is composed of three layers: an epithelium, a connective tissue layer called the lamina propria, and a muscularis mucosae (literally, “muscle of the mucosa”) of smooth muscle.
